title: For The Future
titleLarge: Plan ahead with savings and investment solutions
shortDesc: Build long-term financial security with savings accounts, fixed deposits, and investment options.
desc1: Azania Bank helps you prepare for tomorrow with personal savings and investment products designed to grow your wealth steadily over time.
desc2: Whether you are saving for education, retirement, or a major life goal, our For The Future solutions give you flexible options with competitive returns.

benefits.title: Long-Term Growth
benefits.desc: Grow your savings with structured deposit and investment options.

benefits.title: Financial Security
benefits.desc: Build a safety net for future needs and unexpected events.

benefits.title: Flexible Plans
benefits.desc: Choose tenors and products that match your goals and timeline.

faqs.question: What savings products are available?
faqs.answer: We offer regular savings accounts, fixed deposits, and goal-based savings plans for personal customers.

faqs.question: What is the minimum deposit for a fixed deposit?
faqs.answer: Minimum amounts vary by product. Visit your branch or contact us for current rates and requirements.

faqs.question: Can I open a savings account online?
faqs.answer: You can start the process at any Azania Bank branch with valid identification and required documentation.

title: For Today
shortDesc: Current accounts, debit cards, and digital tools for your daily financial needs.
desc1: For Today is about managing your money with ease — paying bills, receiving salary, transferring funds, and accessing cash when you need it.
desc2: Azania Bank personal accounts come with mobile and internet banking, VISA cards, and a reliable branch and agency network across Tanzania.

benefits.title: Daily Convenience
benefits.desc: Manage everyday transactions quickly and securely.

benefits.title: Digital Access
benefits.desc: Bank from your phone or computer anytime, anywhere.

benefits.title: Wide Network
benefits.desc: Access services through branches, ATMs, and agency points.

faqs.question: What do I need to open a personal current account?
faqs.answer: Valid identification, proof of address, and completed account opening forms are required.

faqs.question: Is mobile banking free?
faqs.answer: Mobile banking enrollment is available to account holders. Standard transaction fees may apply as per the tariff guide.

faqs.question: Can I get a debit card with my account?
faqs.answer: Yes. Eligible personal accounts can be linked to an Azania VISA debit card.

title: For The Family
titleLarge: Banking solutions for your whole family
shortDesc: Joint accounts, children's savings, and family-focused financial products.
desc1: For The Family brings together accounts and savings options that help households manage shared finances and plan for children and dependents.
desc2: From joint accounts for couples to junior savings for children, Azania Bank supports families at every stage.

benefits.title: Shared Management
benefits.desc: Joint accounts allow couples and partners to manage finances together.

benefits.title: Children's Future
benefits.desc: Start saving early for education and other family goals.

benefits.title: One Bank, One Family
benefits.desc: Consolidate family banking with a trusted local partner.

faqs.question: Can I open a joint account?
faqs.answer: Yes. Joint accounts are available for two or more account holders with agreed signatory arrangements.

faqs.question: Is there a savings account for children?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer junior savings accounts designed for minors, managed by a parent or guardian.

faqs.question: How many signatories can a joint account have?
faqs.answer: Signatory arrangements depend on account type. Your branch can explain available options.

title: Loans
titleLarge: Personal loans to meet your goals
shortDesc: Salary advances, personal loans, and asset finance for individuals.
desc1: Azania Bank personal loans help you finance education, home improvements, emergencies, and other personal needs with structured repayment plans.
desc2: Our loan products are designed with transparent terms and assessment processes that consider your income and repayment capacity.

benefits.title: Flexible Purpose
benefits.desc: Finance education, medical needs, home improvements, and more.

benefits.title: Structured Repayment
benefits.desc: Clear schedules aligned to your salary or income cycle.

benefits.title: Quick Assessment
benefits.desc: Efficient processing for eligible personal loan applicants.

faqs.question: Who qualifies for a personal loan?
faqs.answer: Qualification depends on income, employment status, credit history, and ability to repay. Visit your branch for assessment.

faqs.question: What documents are required?
faqs.answer: Typically ID, proof of income, bank statements, and completed loan application forms.

faqs.question: How long does approval take?
faqs.answer: Timelines vary by loan type and documentation completeness. Your branch can provide current estimates.
